entries.45224ac6c98ca179: Based on the corporate message "For diverse Well-being," it is working to realize the long-term management vision "NSK2030" formulated in 2022. It positions fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027 as Phase 2 (measure deployment phase) of that vision, promotes the medium-term management plan "Medium-Term Plan 2027" as its implementation plan, and sets as business strategies "realizing priority areas and creating new businesses," "reviewing the earnings structure and optimizing facilities," and "mutual growth of human resources and the organization and pursuit of social and environmental value." It positions the provision of high value-added products as the solutions business and the provision of materials for daily necessities with cost competitiveness as the primary business, and aims for sustainable growth with a business structure that includes the by-products business. The figures for the target indicators of the medium-term management plan are not transcribed here because they include matters concerning the future.
